items.title: Jerry Coker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 18, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know Don Menza talked about going to — when he was in college he went to the same school I went to... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh my.

ctx.x: Well by then I had already taught in other places and I kind of knew what the other side was thinking. The classical musicians — some of them were very open minded, some of them were not, but as far as I was concerned I wasn’t that concerned about it because if I was to do what I was going to do I wasn’t going to be trying to get along with them that much. And I did always get along with them in a personal way but in a musical way that didn’t mean that much to me.

I know Don Menza talked about going to — when he was in college he went to the same school I went to but he was a few years ahead of me, but they had signs in the practice room “No Jazz Playing.” © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
